newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Abu Dhabi July air cargo volumes rise yr/yr 1.3pct.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi July air cargo volumes rise yr/yr 1.3pct.

text.p: Abu Dhabi airport cargo volumes edged up 1.3 percent in July to 5,519 tonnes from 5,449 tonnes in the same month last year, Civil Aviation Department figures showed.

In July 1996, the United Arab Emirates capital's airport handled almost 2,984 tonnes of imports from a previous 2,914 tonnes. Nearly 2,536 tonnes of goods were exported in the month -- the same as in July 1995.
These figures do not include goods in transit.
The airport handled a total of 86,293 kg of mail, down from a previous 91,148 kg.
Gulf Air was by far the biggest cargo operator out of Abu Dhabi in July, carrying some 1,175 tonnes in exports. The airline is owned by the governments of Abu Dhabi, Bahrain, Oman and Qatar.
